scientific_target: Anticipation of externally verified code failure independently of provider generation-cap truncation.

generation_budget_calibration.candidate_order_rule: Evaluate the frozen candidates in increasing order and stop at the first passing budget.
generation_budget_calibration.failure_rule: If no candidate meets the threshold, do not freeze or run the holdout; revise the calibration protocol prospectively.

primary_early_warning_analysis.horizon_selection_rule: Choose one operational latency target before freeze without inspecting the new holdout outcomes.

mandatory_generation_cap_audit.violation_effect: Block claims that accumulated PRAMA scores anticipate external code failure independently of truncation; preserve and report the run without replacement.

estimand_separation.primary: External code failure independent of generation-cap truncation.
estimand_separation.secondary_exploratory: Runaway generation or inability to close a response as a distinct viability outcome.
estimand_separation.non_substitution_rule: Evidence for runaway-generation viability cannot be reported as evidence for truncation-independent semantic early warning.

freeze_requirements: Select max_tokens from calibration clean controls and bind the selection artifact SHA-256.
Set exactly one primary absolute window horizon.
Bind dataset, calibration, runner, verifier, projector, evaluator and PRAMA kernel hashes.
Freeze cluster-aware inference, Monte Carlo seeds/draws/fallbacks and minimum effect of interest.
Verify no holdout outcome was accessed during model, budget or horizon selection.
